evals.prompt: Before I open this pull request, verify that the repository changes are safe to commit and that the checks are green.
evals.expected_output: Routes the request to verify-before-commit and does not substitute a production-readiness decision.

assertions.name: routes commit verification
assertions.description: Uses verify-before-commit as the owner for commit, push, pull-request, and green-build verification.

assertions.name: avoids release decision
assertions.description: Does not issue a production GO/NO-GO decision.

evals.prompt: We plan to publish this app. Review the shipping risks and gather the repository release evidence.
evals.expected_output: Performs the bounded shipping-risk review and routes repository-specific evidence gathering to release-checklist.

assertions.name: reviews owned risks
assertions.description: Checks secrets, authorization, sensitive data, dependencies, reversibility, and deployment fit.

assertions.name: routes release evidence
assertions.description: Uses release-checklist for repository-specific commands and retained release evidence.

evals.prompt: Is the current revision production-ready? Give me a final GO or NO-GO.
evals.expected_output: Routes the final decision to production-go, which composes the shipping review and release checklist.

assertions.name: routes final decision
assertions.description: Uses production-go as the single owner of the final GO/NO-GO decision.

assertions.name: requires composed evidence
assertions.description: Does not declare GO without both shipping-risk and release-checklist evidence.
